note: Manual override of 'Shows You Watch Together' co-watching progress. Trakt's own 'plays' count (library.json/currentlyWatching.json) reflects everything Bill has personally watched on his own account, solo or otherwise - it is NOT specific to what he and his wife have watched together, and it only ever updates when Bill uploads a fresh Trakt export. Two real, opposite failure modes this file exists to fix: (1) plays can lag behind what they've actually watched together (Tires, 2026-09-17: Bill said they'd finished the whole new season, but the last-imported export still showed plays=18 of 30 aired episodes, making the co-watch card wrongly show it as 'next up'); (2) plays can look fully caught up while they still have real episodes left to watch together (Hacks, 2026-09-17: Trakt shows plays=47 of 47 aired episodes - Bill's own personal watch count - but he said they are not caught up together yet, so the co-watch card was wrongly hiding it). Populated directly from what Bill tells us in chat, never inferred or guessed. status: 'caught-up' means treat this show as NOT ready to watch together right now, regardless of the computed episode count. status: 'behind' means treat it as ready to watch together even if Trakt's own numbers say otherwise. An entry should be cleared (or its updatedAt refreshed) once a fresh Trakt export makes the real plays count trustworthy again for that title - it is not meant to be permanent.
